summary.zh: 文档站索引页从跳转壳升级为真实落地页——把已有的搜索排名转化为点击。
summary.en: The docs index pages are now real landing pages instead of redirect stubs — converting existing search rank into clicks.

highlights.zh: docs.modelswap.app 的 /zh/ 与 /en/ 索引页从 0 秒跳转壳升级为带标题、描述、章节目录的真实页面（该页 Google 排名 2.7，真实页面的点击率远高于空壳）。
highlights.en: The /zh/ and /en/ docs index pages became real pages with title, description, and a chapter directory (the page ranks 2.7 on Google — a real page converts that rank far better than a redirect stub).

highlights.zh: 索引页带完整 SEO 元数据：描述嵌入产品关键数字（41 平台预置 / 10 Agent 适配），canonical 指向自身。
highlights.en: Index pages carry full SEO metadata: descriptions embed the key product numbers (41 provider presets / 10 agent adapters) with self-canonical URLs.

highlights.zh: 站点构建脚本同步产出章节目录导航，双语索引页风格与全站一致。
highlights.en: The site builder now emits a chapter-directory nav on both language index pages, consistent with the rest of the site.
